coverImageAlt: A navy drafting frame organizes six blank hinged paper pockets with cyan pins and an orange corner brace.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: A sturdy architectural drafting frame holding a balanced set of completely blank paper compartments, expressing a dependable product requirements template that gives diverse project information one coherent structure.
Scene/backdrop: Flat warm-paper drafting surface surrounded by deep slate negative space, without rulers, labels, or screens.
Subject: One dominant navy rectangular drafting frame seen nearly straight-on, containing several large asymmetrical warm-paper compartments joined by cyan pins; a single orange corner brace signals readiness.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail; thick cut paper, painted wood, linen hinge tape, and understated handcrafted precision.
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; near-orthographic view; bold rectangular silhouette with few large compartments; crop-safe focal subject; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width; no essential detail in the outer 8%.
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical; soft raking light revealing paper depth with restrained cyan edge glow.
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027.
Materials/textures: deckled paper, matte painted wood, linen tape, subtle fiber and shallow shadows.
Constraints: original image; coherent PRD-template family; one dominant drafting-frame metaphor; all compartments completely blank and unmarked; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling.
Avoid: browser-card layout, dashboard panels, readable grids, blueprint annotations, generic chatbot imagery, glowing brains, Microsoft-like gradients.
Targeted correction: Pull back to a clearly physical oblique tabletop view, keep the complete frame inside the inner 84% with visible warm-paper space around it, and make the compartments visibly hinged handcrafted paper pockets of varied silhouettes rather than a flat dashboard-like rectangular grid; preserve blank surfaces and the single orange brace.
